name: llama.cpp server README - --metrics default disabled, /metrics behaviour, and the /slots alternative
notes:
tools/server/README.md on master, read 2026-10-04. Verbatim option row: '| --metrics | enable prometheus compatible metrics endpoint (default: disabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_ENDPOINT_METRICS) |' next to '| --slots, --no-slots | expose slots monitoring endpoint (default: enabled)
(env: LLAMA_ARG_ENDPOINT_SLOTS) |'. Section 'GET /metrics: Prometheus compatible metrics exporter' states 'This endpoint is only accessible if --metrics is set' and 'In router mode the query param ?model={model_id} has to be set. This endpoint will respond with status code 400 model name is missing from the request if not set.' The asymmetry matters for this record set: the slot-level state endpoint is on by default while the Prometheus endpoint is off by default, so a reader arriving at a stock server finds per-slot JSON and no time series. Same README documents the Available metrics table, which omits prompt_tokens_cached_total that the source does emit.
